title: Receivables & Payables
description: Who owes you and whom you owe — open AR and AP with due-date worklists and the largest customer and supplier balances.
notes: Open documents come from unpaid AR Invoices (OINV) and AP Invoices (OPCH); balances come from the Business Partner master (OCRD). Amounts are document totals; partial payments are not deducted.
